questions.question_text: What is a key characteristic of a strong password?

options.text: It should be short and easy to remember, like your name
It should be at least 12 characters long with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols
It should be the same for all your accounts to avoid forgetting
It should include your birthdate for personal significance

correct_answer.text: It should be at least 12 characters long with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols

questions.question_text: How does a password manager help with account security?

options.text: It automatically logs you into websites without a password
It stores unique, complex passwords securely so you don’t have to remember them
It shares your passwords with trusted friends for backup
It creates weak passwords that are easy to type quickly

correct_answer.text: It stores unique, complex passwords securely so you don’t have to remember them

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?

options.text: To make logging in faster by skipping passwords
To add an extra layer of security by requiring a second step, like a code sent to your phone
To allow others to access your account with a shared code
To store your passwords in a second location for safety

correct_answer.text: To add an extra layer of security by requiring a second step, like a code sent to your phone

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a common sign of a phishing attempt?

options.text: An email from a trusted company with no links or urgent requests
A message claiming “Your account will be deleted in 24 hours!” with a suspicious link
A text from a friend asking how you’re doing without any links
A notification from an app you use with correct spelling and branding

correct_answer.text: A message claiming “Your account will be deleted in 24 hours!” with a suspicious link
